{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2deabb34",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Trajectory Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "In molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, analyzing conformational dynamics and structural fluctuations across trajectories is fundamental. MolSysMT provides a unified set of tools to load trajectories from multiple formats, align structures, and compute time-dependent physical observables such as RMSD, RMSF, radius of gyration, and inter-atomic distances.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9f94324e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Loading a Trajectory\n",
    "\n",
    "We begin by loading an MD trajectory of a pentalanine peptide bundled with MolSysMT:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "e7d82414",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from molsysmt import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "\n",
    "traj_file = msm.systems['pentalanine']['traj_pentalanine.h5msm']\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(traj_file, to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f101d2d1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Let us inspect the system dimensions and topology:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "94420976",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "<style type=\"text/css\">\n",
       "</style>\n",
       "<table id=\"T_ca06c\" class=\"dataframe\">\n",
       "  <thead>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col0\" class=\"col_heading level0 col0\" >form</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col1\" class=\"col_heading level0 col1\" >n_atoms</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col2\" class=\"col_heading level0 col2\" >n_groups</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col3\" class=\"col_heading level0 col3\" >n_components</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col4\" class=\"col_heading level0 col4\" >n_chains</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col5\" class=\"col_heading level0 col5\" >n_molecules</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col6\" class=\"col_heading level0 col6\" >n_entities</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col7\" class=\"col_heading level0 col7\" >n_peptides</th>\n",
       "      <th id=\"T_ca06c_level0_col8\" class=\"col_heading level0 col8\" >n_structures</th>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </thead>\n",
       "  <tbody>\n",
       "    <tr>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col0\" class=\"data row0 col0\" >molsysmt.MolSys</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col1\" class=\"data row0 col1\" >62</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col2\" class=\"data row0 col2\" >7</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col3\" class=\"data row0 col3\" >1</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col4\" class=\"data row0 col4\" >1</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col5\" class=\"data row0 col5\" >1</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col6\" class=\"data row0 col6\" >1</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col7\" class=\"data row0 col7\" >1</td>\n",
       "      <td id=\"T_ca06c_row0_col8\" class=\"data row0 col8\" >100</td>\n",
       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </tbody>\n",
       "</table>\n"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "<pandas.io.formats.style.Styler object at 0x7516b94c3610>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 2,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "msm.info(molsys)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "6917bec1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Loaded trajectory containing 100 structures and 62 atoms.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "n_structures, n_atoms = msm.get(molsys, n_structures=True, n_atoms=True)\n",
    "print(f\"Loaded trajectory containing {n_structures} structures and {n_atoms} atoms.\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c590d015",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Structural Superposition\n",
    "\n",
    "To remove global translational and rotational movements before computing structural deviations, we fit all frames against the first structure using {func}`molsysmt.structure.least_rmsd_fit`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "f75a35b9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.structure.least_rmsd_fit(molsys, selection_fit=\"atom_name=='CA'\", reference_structure_index=0)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "10ad8312",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Root Mean Square Deviation\n",
    "\n",
    "We compute the C-alpha Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD) across time relative to the initial structure using {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_rmsd`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "32acde5c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "\n",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size ...>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "rmsd = msm.structure.get_rmsd(molsys, selection=\"atom_name=='CA'\", reference_structure_index=0)\n",
    "rmsd_val = puw.get_value(rmsd, to_unit='nm')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3.5))\n",
    "plt.plot(rmsd_val, color='#1f77b4', lw=2)\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Frame')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('RMSD (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('C-alpha RMSD Time Series')\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "01636234",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Root Mean Square Fluctuation\n",
    "\n",
    "To identify which residues fluctuate most during the simulation, we calculate the per-residue Root Mean Square Fluctuation (RMSF) using {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_rmsf`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "6b8b4547",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "\n",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size ...>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "rmsf = msm.structure.get_rmsf(molsys, selection=\"atom_name=='CA'\")\n",
    "rmsf_val = puw.get_value(rmsf, to_unit='nm')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 3.5))\n",
    "plt.bar(range(1, len(rmsf_val) + 1), rmsf_val, color='#ff7f0e', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Residue Index')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('RMSF (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('Per-Residue C-alpha Fluctuation')\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "43a07e22",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Radius of Gyration\n",
    "\n",
    "The radius of gyration measures the overall compactness of the peptide structure over time using {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_radius_of_gyration`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "d95e1e79",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "\n",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size ...>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "rg = msm.structure.get_radius_of_gyration(molsys, selection='all')\n",
    "rg_val = puw.get_value(rg, to_unit='nm')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3.5))\n",
    "plt.plot(rg_val, color='#2ca02c', lw=2)\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Frame')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Radius of Gyration (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('Peptide Compactness Over Time')\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e84b4224",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## End-to-End Distance\n",
    "\n",
    "We can also monitor internal distance metrics, such as the distance between terminal C-alpha atoms across all trajectory frames using {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_distances`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "4967453f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "\n",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size ...>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "end_to_end = msm.structure.get_distances(molsys, selection=\"group_index==1 and atom_name=='CA'\", selection_2=\"group_index==5 and atom_name=='CA'\")\n",
    "end_to_end_val = puw.get_value(end_to_end[:, 0, 0], to_unit='nm')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 3.5))\n",
    "plt.plot(end_to_end_val, color='#9467bd', lw=2)\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Frame')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Distance (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('Terminal C-alpha Distance')\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d4af3b2c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Extracting Conformations\n",
    "\n",
    "We can extract specific conformational states from the trajectory, such as the frame with minimum radius of gyration (most compact conformation) using {func}`molsysmt.basic.extract`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "d910f688",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Extracted most compact structure at frame 56.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "min_rg_frame = int(np.argmin(rg_val))\n",
    "compact_molsys = msm.extract(molsys, structure_indices=min_rg_frame)\n",
    "print(f\"Extracted most compact structure at frame {min_rg_frame}.\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "749c4af4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Interactive Visualization\n",
    "\n",
    "Finally, we visualize the trajectory in 3D with MolSysViewer:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "4b17570c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "<iframe src=\"../../_static/views/showcase_md_trajectory.html\" width=\"100%\" height=\"480px\" style=\"border:none;\"></iframe>\n"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "'<iframe src=\"../../_static/views/showcase_md_trajectory.html\" width=\"100%\" height=\"480px\" style=\"border:none;\"></iframe>'"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "msm.view(molsys)\n"
   ]
  }
 ],
